Crop Diversity Subindex

Source: vignettes/articles/Diversity.Rmd
Diversity.Rmd

Plant Species Richness over 4-Year Spans, with a Grazing Credit

Overview

The Diversity subindex counts how many plant species grow in a field over each 4-year span of the record, and averages the counts. Crop rotation, cover crops and seed mixes all raise it. Grazing animals raise it further. The score runs from 0 to 100.

1. Species

Each distinct crop name is a species (extra whitespace ignored). Before counting:

  • placeholder mixtures such as "8-species", "8 spp" or "8-species mix" count as that many species;
  • names joined by "+" ("A + B") are split into separate species;
  • rows named "fallow", "none" or "bare" are not plants.

2. Richness per span

For management unit ii, each 4-year span of the evaluation window, starting in each calendar year in turn, has a richness: the number of species present on any day of it. A record of 4 years or fewer is one span. The richness R‾i\bar{R}_i is the average over spans.

compute_diversity(window = 1) counts species per calendar year instead (the SHMI 1.0 definition); options(SHMI.diversity_window = ) changes the window for a session.

3. Scaling to 0–100

Dplants,i=100×min(R‾i−18−1,1) D_{plants,i} = 100 \times \min\left(\frac{\bar{R}_i - 1}{8 - 1},\; 1\right)

One species scores 0, and eight or more score 100. A span without any plants counts as zero species, so a bare fallow scores 0.

4. Grazing credit

Animals grazing in a share panimalp_{animal} of years close a quarter of that share of the gap to 100:

Diversityi=Dplants,i+0.25panimal,i(100−Dplants,i) \text{Diversity}_i = D_{plants,i} + 0.25\,p_{animal,i}\,(100 - D_{plants,i})

Every calendar year overlapped by a grazing period counts. Grazing every year raises a corn–soybean rotation from 14 to 36, and a diverse pasture already at 80 to 85. The credit cannot push Diversity past 100.

Interpretation

  • 0: one species, such as continuous corn.
  • 14: two species, such as a corn–soybean rotation.
  • 29: three, such as corn–soybean–wheat; 43 with a rye cover crop added.
  • 100: eight or more species, such as a diverse cover-crop mix or a species-rich perennial stand.

Output

compute_diversity() returns plant-only Diversity, one row per management unit:

MGT_combo Diversity Richness
… 0–100 species per 4-year span

shmi_components() and build_shmi() return Diversity with the grazing credit, Diversity_plants without it, and p_animal.
